classification.difficultyReason: Translate the stated cubic relationship into a model, calibrate it with the known speed and power, and evaluate it at the new speed before rounding.

content.prompt: The power $p$ kilowatts needed to run a boat varies as the cube of its speed $s$ metres per second. If 400 kW will run a boat at 3 m/s, what power, to the nearest kilowatt, is needed to run the same boat at 5 m/s?

answer.worked:
Since $p\propto s^3$,
$$\begin{align*}p &= ks^3\\400 &= k\times3^3\\k &= \frac{400}{27}\\p &= \frac{400}{27}s^3\end{align*}$$
When $s=5$,
$$\begin{align*}p &= \frac{400}{27}\times5^3\\p &= \frac{50000}{27}\\p &\approx 1852\text{ kW}\end{align*}$$
The required power is 1852 kW, to the nearest kilowatt.
